correctness.rationale: Independently replayed every per-Betti computation from generator strings with a fresh stdlib implementation: gcd=1 and minimal generation hold for all 9 triples; Apery sets match via both Dijkstra residue-graph and brute membership search; c_i minimality holds (witness representation at c_i, exhaustive failure below); every listed Betti factorization list is complete by exhaustive 3-generator double loop; length sets, consecutive-gap Delta sets, R-class Betti certificates (>1 component via shared-atom graph), and distance-threshold catenary degrees all match, including spot distances (e.g. d((0,1,1),(5,0,0))=5 at 20 in <4,9,11>; pairwise distances 3,5,5 at 30 in <6,10,15> giving cat 5; d=2 at 14 in <5,7,9>). Betti keys equal the distinct c_i*n_i values on every row, consistent with cited ed-3 presentation theory, and brute Betti scan to 400 finds no additional Betti elements (re-checked); brute Delta-union and max-cat scans to 400 match Betti-derived globals on all rows, extended by auditor to 2000 for Delta with continued agreement. Extremals verified: min cat 3 at <4,6,9> (tied with <5,6,9>); max Delta value 3 at <4,9,11> and <5,8,11>; witness 20 in <4,9,11> has lengths {2,5}, gap 3. Global Delta-union and cat-max steps explicitly invoke cited external Betti-determination theorems (not re-proved) with bound-400 agreement as corroboration only; DRAFT states this dependence honestly, so global columns are proved conditional on standard cited results. Verifier replays VERIFY_OK from committed strings with stdlib only.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, not timestamp logic. arXiv:1909.09419 (Garcia-Sanchez/Martin-Cruz) gives general ed-3 equality characterizations (Theorems 3.7, 3.9) and formulas via c_i/r_ij plus isolated illustrations; full-text scan shows exactly one committed-row overlap: S=<5,6,9> with Delta={1}, cat=3 (case 5b), disclosed in DRAFT as a re-derived control. The other 8 triples (<4,6,9>, <4,7,9>, <4,6,11>, <4,9,11>, <5,7,9>, <5,8,11>, <6,7,11>, <6,10,15>) appear nowhere in that paper (all langle instances enumerated; examples are <10,14,53>, <6,8,15>, <4,10,17>, <10,16,35>, <9,10,25>, <5,14,21>, <4,9,15>, <4,5,7>, <7,11,38>, etc.), and no 9-row Betti-certified Delta/catenary table with equality verdicts and two extremals is recorded there. arXiv:1503.08351 proves eventual periodicity/quasilinearity via Hilbert functions with no exact values for these triples. arXiv:1503.05993 treats the disjoint compound-sequence family with bounds only. GAP NumericalSgps Chap.4 documents Betti/presentation functions (including a (4,6,9) presentation example) but publishes no Delta/cat tables. The 8 new rows plus certificates, combined verdict table, and extremal witnesses require fresh enumeration and are not mechanically implied as a stated result.

value.rationale: Headline result is a rigorously established exact invariant of specific natural objects: Delta sets, maxDelta, catenary degrees, and maxDelta+2 vs cat verdicts with full Betti factorization certificates for 9 committed ed-3 multiplicity 4-6 semigroups, plus a certified minimal-catenary equality extremal (<4,6,9>, c=3) and maximal Delta-gap witness (element 20 in <4,9,11>, lengths {2,5}, gap 3). Object and invariant were motivated before computation by the recognized nonunique-factorization program (Delta/catenary sharpness boundary of Chapman/Garcia-Sanchez/Geroldinger/O'Neill); values were not known and are not mechanically implied; a future researcher can reasonably need the precise per-semigroup facts for test suites and sharpness checks. Narrowness alone does not disqualify an exact datum under the applicable standard; completeness of the wider multiplicity band is not claimed and the incomplete-scope table is described honestly. Certification alone is not doing the work here: motivation, boundary verdicts, and extremal witnesses give mathematical interpretation beyond an unexplained number.
